subtitle: Base measures, plus a company-wide benchmark

code:
Total Sales = SUM ( FactProductSales[LineTotal] )

Order Count =
  DISTINCTCOUNT ( FactProductSales[SalesOrderID] )

Average Order Value =
  DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Order Count] )
caption: DISTINCTCOUNT handles the line-level grain; DIVIDE handles the zero case.

code:
Total Sales (All Territories) =
CALCULATE (
    [Total Sales],
    ALL ( DimTerritory )
)

Pct of Company Total =
  DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Total Sales (All Territories)] )
caption: This exact unfiltered total is what Finance's Excel number gets checked against later.
